# docs/memory/designer/

<!-- Generated by php tools/memory_index.php, except the key rules between the two marker lines, which are written by hand. -->

Visual designer, system widgets, data binding, designer forms, member widgets, content roles, HTML import.

## Key rules

<!-- key-rules:start -->
- Put every system widget function on a data binding, never on a CSS class: an element deleted and re-added with the same binding must keep working (`system-widget-bindings.md`).
- Give a link's window as the `target` prop, never in a starter's or template's `_attrs` (`rel: noopener` may stay there); `_attrs` prints only for an empty prop and `migrateNodeLinkProps()` folds it in (`link-target-in-attrs.md`).
- Treat `pg_designer_merge_restricted_tree()` (in `pg_designer_save_page()`) as the content-role gate: it copies, never rejects; `_sdMayEdit` is courtesy (`designer-content-roles-save-gate.md`).
- Check the page lock on the save path (`pg_collab_may_edit_page()`), not with a disabled button; claim it in one upsert with `session_key` set last (`designer-collab-locking.md`).
- Name every widget's Messages node with `_pg_inject_messages_node($tree, '<liveform>')`, never `''`, or one widget prints and uses up another form's errors (`system-widget-render-rules.md`).
- Escape token values once (`pg_sw_apply_tokens()`, raw keys in `pg_sw_raw_token_keys()`), never add a second name for a system field, run `php tools/check_bindings.php` (`token-dictionary.md`).
- A switched-off feature emits nothing on the site and fades on the canvas (PHP and JS twins together); never ship a visible but dead element (`catalog-binding-disabled-no-output.md`).
- Compare widget output with the legacy page doing the same job; change a default layout in all three places: PHP tree, JS starter tree, server fallback (`system-widget-change-checklist.md`).
- Build a palette component as a tree of semantic nodes with Bootstrap classes: no script, stylesheet or fixed inline style, and `render()` equal to `toHTML()` (`palette-component-rules.md`).
- Resolve canvas elements with `_sdFindNodeForEl(id, el)` and parents with `_sdAnyParent(node)`: `findNodeById()` is null inside widgets and shared components (`designer-find-node-for-el.md`).
- Keep `shared_ref.children` empty (`[]`): a shared component is drawn per request from its row; never write its expanded children into a stored tree (`shared-component-model.md`).
- Mark the component a node lives in when a path writes the node without selecting it (`_sdSharedMarkEdited(node)`); never take a snapshot after a change, or Save skips it as unchanged (`shared-component-editor-cache.md`).
- Add a new page-save dependency beyond the page's tree and settings to `_pgPageUnchanged()`, or Save skips the page as unchanged (`multi-page-designer-editor.md`).
- Draw output that depends on the request as a placeholder in `pg_tr_finalize()`, never into the saved page body (`language-switcher-component.md`).
- Keep site output (palette components, widget and starter markup, design templates, the canvas) on Bootstrap 5.3.8; only the editor's own chrome and dialogs are Bootstrap 6 like the panel, and the `.claude/skills/bootstrap-*` skills never apply to site output (`ui/bootstrap-6.md`).
- Mark a new style_designer.js member that writes page markup or draws the canvas with `/* @pg-site-output */` on the line above it, or `bs6_migrate.php` and `check_bs6.php` read its classes as panel code (`ui/bootstrap-6-editor-markers.md`).
- Build a design template's missing sector sections first as a palette block family, then give its home and signature pages their own composition and `_fx` motion where it fits; never copy another template's builders or band sequence (`design-template-own-look.md`).
- Redraw a one-node text, property or style edit with `_sdRenderNode(node, …)`; a structure change, or a prop another node reads, keeps the full `render()` (`designer-incremental-canvas.md`).
- Start a new panel's drawing function with `_sdPanelDefer(name)` and debounce per-keystroke panel draws with `_sdPanelsSoon(node)`; the canvas stays live (`designer-panels-on-demand.md`).
<!-- key-rules:end -->
